hints.text: Register an account and watch the network tab when you open My Records.
The API only checks that you're logged in, not whose record you asked for. Try lower record numbers — the first one is special.
Your session cookie is a JWT. Decode it (jwt.io or base64) and look at the claims.
The HS256 key is a dictionary word. Crack it with hashcat -m 16500 or john --format=HMAC-SHA256 and rockyou.txt, then re-sign the token with role=admin.
The admin letter editor fills in {{ placeholders }}. What happens with {{ 7*7 }}?
It's Flask/Jinja2. Flask keeps its settings in an object every template can see: {{ config }}.
Jinja2 templates can reach Python globals. Look for objects whose __init__.__globals__ contain the os module.
